FN-L5492AY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 274
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/13/2026
Senate Bill 274 as introduced would reduce license fee receipts to the Alabama Board of
Cosmetology and Barbering by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of licensed
individuals and salons that currently only provide blow-dry styling that would no longer need to
be licensed pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-L5492AY-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 274
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/06/2026
Senate Bill 274 as passed the Senate would reduce license fee receipts to the Alabama Board of
Cosmetology and Barbering by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of license
fees paid by individuals and salons that currently only provide blow-dry styling that would no
longer required to be licensed pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
